einzeiler: Apple introduces major OS updates, new child safety tools, and next-gen AI features.
kurzfassung: Apple showcases software platform updates at WWDC26, featuring system performance boosts and a redesigned Liquid Glass aesthetic. The company introduces expanded parental controls and family management tools grounded in expert health research. Additionally, a revamped Siri powered by Apple Intelligence brings advanced reasoning, visual awareness, and deep app integration across devices.
stichpunkte: macOS is officially named Golden Gate following a comedic opening sketch
Performance improvements include 30% faster app launches and an optimized CPU scheduler for older devices
Design refinements introduce customizable Liquid Glass sliders, uniform toolbars, and edge-to-edge sidebars
Child safety updates add Ask to Browse, granular time allowances, and customizable app schedules for parents
Apple partners with Google to power the next generation of Apple Foundation models
Siri receives a major conversational upgrade with personal context understanding and on-screen awareness
Visual intelligence enables users to search, translate, and interact with physical objects directly through the camera
New productivity features in Safari include automatic tab organization and page monitoring with Notify Me
Photos gains advanced generative editing tools like spatial reframing and enhanced cleanup capabilities
Developer tools in Xcode add agentic coding support and the unified Device Hub for testing

kapitel.titel: Trust and Safety Controls for Families

clips.hook: iOS 27 supports devices all the way back to the iPhone 11
clips.text: Extended software longevity allows older hardware models to receive the newest operating system update, maintaining broad compatibility.

clips.hook: Experts recommend strict boundaries for young users and technology
clips.text: Child development guidelines suggest keeping children under thirteen away from social media while giving parents ultimate customization control.

clips.hook: Apple processes artificial intelligence queries without retaining personal user
clips.text: On-device processing and private cloud compute ensure that individual requests remain completely private and inaccessible to outside parties.

clips.hook: Spatial computing eliminates wake words on augmented reality headsets
clips.text: Users can interact with the digital assistant simply by gazing at it and speaking naturally in a three-dimensional environment.

clips.hook: Cloud-based generative features require daily usage limits
clips.text: Advanced server models power resource-heavy functions, with increased capacity bundled into premium cloud subscription plans.

beschreibung: Tune in to the WWDC26 keynote introducing Siri AI powered by Apple Intelligence — our most personal Siri update ever. You’ll also learn about expanded trust and safety features, and improvements to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27, and tvOS 27.
